summary: Test-writing (red) phase for #5 'Replace hand-written API layer with a generated OpenAPI Swift client'. Added always-on failing contract tests for the vendored OpenAPI document (iOS/openapi.yaml) and Package.swift wiring (swift-openapi-generator/runtime, OpenAPIGeneratorTarget plugin, ColorMatchingOpenAPI module, AppCore import), plus compile-gated GeneratedClientTests (#if canImport(ColorMatchingOpenAPI)) exercising all six surfaces against an in-process StubTransport with no live server. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the hand-written layer are recorded in docs/generated-openapi-client-verification.md for the PR description. All implementation-dependent criteria are intentionally red/not_run pending the implementation run; no Swift toolchain exists in this container (CI runs swift test on macos-latest), so statuses reflect static evidence at this PR head.
